title: Overture of the Final Battle
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's voice resounded across the heavens and the three realms' coalition answered in unison, the slumbering consciousness in the depths of the Void finally opened its eyes...

text.content: The sigh still echoed in his ears, yet Chen Ji remained motionless, as if it were merely the Void's idle murmur. He slowly closed his eyes, his divine sense spreading like a tide across the three realms—the demonic army of East Sheng Divine Continent stood ready, the scattered cultivators' alliance of North Desolate Ice Plain had broken through the ice heading south, the rebels of Western Heaven Buddhist Kingdom provided covert support, and even in the outskirts of the celestial realm, several hidden auras responded to him from afar. A hundred years of preparation, today finally brings the endgame. The corner of his lips lifted slightly, revealing a placid smile—Cang Yutian, did you think we were the only ones playing this game?

dialogue.content: "Not bad, not bad." Ripples spread through the Void as an illusory figure slowly formed. Mo Xiansheng still appeared as an elegant scholar, yet the aura flowing around him caused Chen Ji's pupils to contract sharply—that was pressure far beyond the Transformed God realm, ancient vastness even the Heavenly Dao will had to respect. Mo Xiansheng stood with hands clasped behind his back, a trace of nostalgia flickering in his turbid eyes, "You've done better than I expected. For this moment, I've waited a full three thousand years."

text.content: "Three thousand years?" Chen Ji showed no surprise, simply watching this master soul remnant that had accompanied him for years. Mo Xiansheng sighed softly, raised his hand and waved, a crack appearing in the Void revealing behind it the vast starry sea and submerged civilization ruins. "Did you think I was some guardian? Merely a wisp of obsession. I was the 'Heavenly Secrets Walker' of the previous epoch, just like you, having grasped the complete Tianji Record..." His voice gradually lowered, "But I failed. And you... you are my last hope."

The Tianji Record Fragment within Chen Ji vibrated violently, as if sensing some summoning. Mo Xiansheng pressed down with an illusory hand, and the trembling immediately ceased. "The Tianji Record contains nine pages, corresponding to nine layers of heavenly secrets. My wisp of soul is merely the guardian consciousness of the first page. And you... have unknowingly collected seven pages." Complex light flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes, "When the ninth page returns to its place, you will possess all conditions to challenge the cosmic will. Cang Yutian is merely the chosen gatekeeper."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly. That laughter held mockery, relief, and a trace of indescribable arrogance. "So over these hundred years, I thought I was battling heaven and fighting fate, but I was merely a piece on two seniors' chessboard?" He raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment appearing in his palm, seven rays of light interweaving and flowing, "But it doesn't matter. Whether a piece or a chess player—as long as the ending is what I want."

choice.prompt: With the celestial army pressing at the border, Chen Ji faces the critical choice of the final layout:

choices.text: Personally command the three realms' coalition
choices.description: With Chen Ji as the core, gather the strongest combat power of the three realms, directly clash with Cang Yutian's celestial army, crushing all obstacles with absolute dominance.
choices.visible_reward: The three realms' coalition's morale greatly increases, combat power rises to its peak
choices.risk_hint: Become the primary target of the Heavenly Dao will, extremely dangerous
choices.process_label: 陈机决定以绝对实力正面碾压

dialogue.content: Han Lie laughed loudly toward the sky, his laughter full of exhilaration: "Good! Chen Ji, you've finally stood up to fight alongside me! Hahaha! These hypocrites from the celestial realm, I've long been fed up with them!" He strode forward, heavily slapping Chen Ji's shoulder, his eyes blazing with battle intent.

choices.text: Let Han Lie command the coalition
choices.description: With Han Lie as the coalition commander, Chen Ji retreats behind the scenes to control the overall situation, leveraging strategic advantages to arrange the ultimate killing move in the shadows.
choices.visible_reward: Keep trump cards, can reverse the situation at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's impulsive personality may cause trouble
choices.process_label: 陈机决定隐藏实力，让韩烈做明面统帅

text.content: Han Lie was stunned at first, then his eyes gleamed brilliantly. He stared at Chen Ji in disbelief: "You... you want me to be commander?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Brother Han's combat power is unmatched, your aura is overwhelming, only you commanding the three realms' coalition can deter the wicked. I'm merely a useless person, hiding behind to offer suggestions." Han Lie burst into hearty laughter, snatching the commander's seal: "Good! I will certainly not fail your trust!"

choices.text: Use oneself as bait to lure the enemy
choices.description: Chen Ji decides to use himself as bait, drawing all of Cang Yutian's attention to himself, creating an opportunity for the three realms' coalition's fatal strike.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the full siege of the celestial realm
choices.visible_reward: Create the best attack timing for the coalition, reducing overall casualties
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will be drastically consumed, possibly damaging the foundation
choices.process_label: 陈机决意以身为饵，承受最大压力

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's form trembled, his ethereal figure betraying a glimmer of tears: "Foolish child... do you understand that failure in this game means utter destruction?" Chen Ji replied softly: "I know. But if I don't pay the price, why would these people die for me?" His gaze swept across the Three Realms allied forces behind him, his voice low yet resolute: "I've never been a good person, but since we've come this far—let me be a true chess player just once."

text.content: At that moment, a thunderous roar echoed from the heavens. Countless golden-armored divine beings descended from the nine celestial layers, their silver war banners darkening half the sky. At the very front stood an unmistakable figure—Cang Yutian. Clad in nine-dragon golden robes, with a halo of Heavenly Fate encircling his head, his gaze upon all living beings dripped with disdain and arrogance. "Chen Ji," his voice thundered like celestial judgment, "I offer you one final chance. Kneel, present the Tianji Record, and I shall grant you a merciful death."

Chen Ji slowly turned, facing the overwhelming celestial army. His expression was terrifyingly calm, even carrying a hint of a smile. Behind him, the Demon Path Saint Ye Qing stepped forward, demonic energy churning around her form. The Nascent Soul cultivators of the rogue cultivator alliance released their imposing auras in unison. Even the rebels at the edges of the heavens brandished weapons they had hidden for years. The combined might of three realms crystallized into an almost tangible form, resembling an unparalleled divine sword about to be unsheathed.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian," Chen Ji's voice was quiet yet clearly reached everyone present, "do you truly believe you've come to punish me?" He gently raised his hand, and the fragments of the Tianji Record transformed into seven streams of light orbiting around him. "No, you've merely come to deliver your own death. Heaven chose you as its gatekeeper, but did it reveal what's truly sealed beyond that threshold?" The moment his words fell, an agonized howl erupted from the depths of the Void, as if some ancient existence had been awakened.

text.content: Cang Yutian's complexion shifted subtly. The hundreds of thousands of celestial troops behind him began to stir with unease. Suddenly, another thunderous roar echoed from the horizon. A massive war banner emblazoned with the Xuanwu emblem tore through the clouds. Han Lie rode a primordial beast at breakneck speed, with a million imperial troops following in his wake. The imperial forces had arrived! "Ha ha ha!" Han Lie's laughter shook the heavens, "Chen Ji! I've come to keep my promise! Anyone who dares touch you will have to answer my fists first!"

Chen Ji observed the vast reinforcements, a complex light flickering in his eyes. Han Lie, once a rival he had repeatedly outwitted, now stood shoulder to shoulder with him. He suddenly burst into genuine, unrestrained laughter. "Han Lie," his voice cut through the chaos, "are you certain? Standing with me means defying Heaven itself." Han Lie flashed a grin, revealing a set of white teeth: "I've despised Heaven my entire life! Let's crush it!"

choice.prompt: The Three Realms allied forces have assembled. Faced with Cang Yutian's provocation, Chen Ji must make his response.

choices.description: Chen Ji directly issued a war declaration to Cang Yutian, announcing the Three Realms' resistance with the most domineering attitude, humiliating Cang Yutian completely.
choices.visible_cost: Cang Yutian might attack immediately on the spot.
choices.visible_reward: The morale of the Three Realms allied forces soars, Cang Yutian is thoroughly humiliated.
choices.process_label: 陈机以绝对霸气回应挑衅

text.content: Chen Ji advanced slowly, each step pressing down on Cang Yutian's heart. In full view of the massive crowd, he pressed his palm onto the Tianji Record, causing seven beams of light to shoot skyward, forming a luminous column reaching into the heavens. "Heaven and earth bear witness," Chen Ji's cold, mocking voice rang out, "today, the废物 Chen Ji challenges the heavens!" Cang Yutian trembled with fury, yet dared not retreat before the public eye—he was already caught in an inescapable position.

choices.description: Chen Ji pretends to negotiate with Cang Yutian while secretly deploying troops and setting up an ultimate formation, waiting for the perfect moment to strike decisively.
choices.visible_reward: Can launch a lethal strike at a critical moment.
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, all efforts will be wasted.
choices.process_label: 陈机决定以智取胜，暗中布置

dialogue.content: Ye Qing understood his intentions perfectly, quietly withdrawing into the formation. Her hands formed intricate seals as waves of demonic energy transformed into countless invisible threads, weaving an expansive net within the Void. The "Demonic Path Mist" spread silently, completely masking Chen Ji's presence. Meanwhile, Chen Ji himself assumed a negotiating posture before the watching crowd, completely unaware that beneath the concealing demonic energy, a supreme killing formation capable of trapping and annihilating the Heavenly Emperor was taking shape.

choices.description: Before the battle, Chen Ji shares his genuine thoughts with everyone, exchanging sincerity for sincerity, making everyone's resolve to fight for him even stronger.
choices.visible_reward: The loyalty of the Three Realms allied forces increases significantly, all receive morale bonuses.
choices.risk_hint: May be exploited by the enemy.
choices.process_label: 陈机敞开心扉，以真心换真心

text.content: Chen Ji turned to face the densely packed allied forces behind him, then deeply bowed. "Everyone," his voice somewhat hoarse, "I, Chen Ji, am merely a废物. The greatest luck in my life was meeting all of you." He lifted his head, tears glistening in his eyes: "Regardless of today's outcome, I, Chen Ji, hereby pledge—if I survive, I will share prosperity with all of you; if I die..." He paused, "The debts I owe you, I will repay in my next life!" The Three Realms allied forces were all deeply moved, countless cultivators' eyes grew red.

Just as this happened, the sky suddenly changed color. Countless golden chains burst forth from the Void, encircling the entire edge of the Heavenly Realm. Cang Yutian's expression turned completely gloomy: 'Chen Ji, did you really think this Lord would give you the chance to set your trap?' With a single command, the Heavenly Realm's army surged forward like a tide. Meanwhile, from the depths of the Void came an aged yet commanding voice: 'Chen Ji, enough.' It was—Ling Yuan. The old Patriarch of the Tianqing Sect had finally appeared. His figure stood atop the clouds like a mountain, gazing down at the insects below, a contemptuous smile hanging from his lips.

'Chen Ji,' Ling Yuan's voice thundered like rolling thunder, 'do you truly believe this rabble can challenge Heaven? This old man has waited three hundred years for this day.' His gaze swept over Mo Xiansheng, a flicker of greed in his eyes. 'The complete Tianji Record... it should have been mine!' Mo Xiansheng冷笑一声: 'Yours? You are merely a failure eliminated by the Tianji Record. Ling Yuan, you will never understand what it means to 'let go', so you will never become a true Chess Player.' Ling Yuan's face turned ashen, his aura surging: 'Then let this old man show you what true power looks like!'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan personally intervened, and the Three Realms Alliance faced unprecedented pressure. Chen Ji's choice would determine the direction of the battlefield:

choices.description: Chen Ji personally confronts Ling Yuan head-on, using the power of the Tianji Record to suppress this great enemy who had been coveting for years, letting him understand what he had missed over these hundred years.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan is crushed, utterly humiliated
choices.risk_hint: May expose the full power of the Tianji Record
choices.process_label: 陈机亲自迎战凌渊，展示真正实力

text.content: Chen Ji stepped into the air, all seven pages of the Tianji Record emerging to form a wheel of light piercing through heaven and earth. Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically—he never expected this waste to have hidden such strength! The two powers collided in the air, and Ling Yuan spat blood, flying backward. 'Impossible!' he howled, 'You're merely trash! Trash!' Chen Ji looked down from above, his gaze ice-cold: 'Trash? Old fool, did you think I was sleeping all these hundred years?'

choices.description: Chen Ji刺激 Ling Yuan with the most vicious and sharp words, psychologically crushing the old Patriarch and making him reveal weaknesses in his anger.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan may go berserk and lose control
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's emotions are greatly disturbed, creating an opportunity for the Alliance
choices.risk_hint: An enraged Ling Yuan may act recklessly
choices.process_label: 陈机以言语为刃，攻击凌渊心理防线

dialogue.content: Chen Ji chuckled lightly, the smile full of mockery: 'Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, you lived three hundred years, just to become a dog?' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present, 'A failure eliminated by the Tianji Record, trash rejected by the Heavenly Dao—you think you're something?'. Ling Yuan trembled with rage: 'You... how dare you!' Chen Ji嗤笑: 'What wouldn't I dare? It's just the truth. Your greatest value in this life is humiliating yourself publicly today—that counts as waste utilization.'

choices.description: Chen Ji mobilizes all Nascent Soul cultivators from the Three Realms Alliance to attack from multiple angles, crushing Ling Yuan through numerical superiority with堂堂正正的 force, demonstrating the Alliance's unity.
choices.visible_cost: May suffer losses among some Alliance experts
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan is besieged by the Alliance,狼狈不堪
choices.risk_hint: The Alliance's coordination may have gaps
choices.process_label: 陈机调动联军强者围攻凌渊

text.content: Chen Ji gave the order, and over twenty Nascent Soul experts from the Three Realms Alliance all struck simultaneously! Han Lie led the charge, his punch carrying world-destroying force; Ye Qing's Demonic Path divine arts followed closely; the Nascent Soul elders from the loose cultivator alliance also refused to be outdone. Ling Yuan's face instantly turned deathly pale—he was strong, but how could he withstand so many people attacking together? 'You... resorting to numbers!' he roared. Chen Ji冷笑: 'Old man, in all your years, haven't you learned one lesson? — when you can beat someone as a group, who would fight solo?'

At the critical moment when the Three Realms Alliance faced off against the Heavenly Realm army, a massive rift suddenly tore open in the depths of the Void. An eye formed from pure Heavenly Dao will slowly opened from within the crack. It was—the Heavenly Dao's Eye! It held no emotion whatsoever, only cold scrutiny. A voice rang out in everyone's mind: 'Enough.' These two words seemed to contain world-destroying power, causing everyone present to involuntarily stop their movements. Cang Yutian's face changed drastically, and he hastily knelt: 'Disciple Cang Yutian respectfully welcomes the descent of Heavenly Dao's Will!' Ling Yuan also dropped all aura, bowing respectfully.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared directly at that indifferent eye, his spine straight. The Heavenly Dao's Eye gazed back at him, as if measuring something. After a long while, that voice spoke again: 'Chen Ji, do you know your crime?' Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter exceptionally harsh in the silence. 'Crime?' He looked up directly at the Heavenly Dao, 'What crime could I possibly have committed?' The Heavenly Dao's Eye narrowed slightly, and terrifying pressure poured down like a mountain. Yet Chen Ji remained unmoved, the Tianji Record Fragment forming a barrier around him. He spoke word by word: 'Heavenly Dao? You're merely a watchdog for the cosmic will. Today, I came to challenge your authority.'

text.content: The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent. That terrifying pressure suddenly vanished, replaced by an even deeper aura. It seemed to be reassessing this insignificant human. 'Interesting.' Its voice carried a hint of amusement, 'For a thousand years, you are the first to dare speak to this Lord in such a manner.' Chen Ji嗤笑: 'That's because no one before had my strength.' He slowly raised his hand, and nine-page phantoms of the Tianji Record manifested behind him. Though only seven pages were substantial, the scene was already astonishing. 'Now, I give you two choices—either retreat to your Heavenly Dao's palace; or today, let me show you what true 'Heavenly Secrets' truly mean.'

Just as tensions reached their peak, Mo Xiansheng suddenly stepped in front of Chen Ji. His form appeared even more ethereal than before, as if he might dissipate at any moment. 'Heavenly Dao's Will,' his voice calm yet firm, 'three thousand years, haven't you grown tired of this game yet?' The Heavenly Dao's Eye contracted sharply, as if seeing something utterly unimaginable. 'You... how could you still not have completely dissipated?' Mo Xiansheng轻笑: 'Thanks to your grace. In that battle back then, I may have been defeated, but I died with honor.' He turned to Chen Ji, his eyes full of relief, 'Child, what comes next is left to you.' With those words, his form turned into a stream of light, merging into the Tianji Record Fragment within Chen Ji.

The Tianji Record Fragment vibrated violently, and the light of the eighth page suddenly blazed! Mo Xiansheng's three-thousand-year obsession had become the key to unsealing this page. Chen Ji felt power surging within his body, an unprecedented sense of fullness washing over him. He lowered his gaze to his palm, where the complete form of the Tianji Record flickered in and out of view—eight pages in hand, only one last page away from true completeness. "Thank you, Master," he murmured softly, then raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade, staring directly at the Heavenly Eye. "Now, do you still wish to speak with me about 'acknowledging your crime'?"

The Heavenly Eye remained silent for a long while, then slowly retreated, vanishing into the depths of the Void. That voice sounded one final time: "Chen Ji, this one has remembered you." Cang Yutian's face turned deathly pale—he never imagined that the Heavenly Will would actually yield! Ling Yuan trembled all over, suddenly realizing that the Heavenly Dao he had followed for several hundred years had chosen to retreat before this waste! "Impossible..." he murmured, "This is impossible..." Chen Ji turned around, gazing at the vast Three Realms Alliance behind him, a smile curling at the corner of his lips.

Chen Ji stood at the edge of the Heavenly Realm, behind him the Three Realms Alliance, before him the silhouette of the Heavenly Hall. The wind lifted his robes, stirring his disheveled hair. Han Lie walked to his side and patted his shoulder: "What comes next?" Chen Ji gazed at the unattainable hall in the distance, then lightly exhaled: "Not yet." He turned to face the crowd, his gaze firm and profound. "Today, let Cang Yutian and Ling Yuan carry the news back. Let them tell the Heavenly Dao—Chen Ji has arrived." His voice was not loud, yet it seemed to explode like thunder in everyone's heart. "Tomorrow at this hour, the final battle begins!" The Three Realms Alliance roared in unison, the sound wave surging toward the heavens, causing even the flying eaves of the Heavenly Hall to tremble slightly.
